title: Newest First by Default
description: Without touching any sort controls, a dispatcher opening the tracking table should see their most recently booked shipment at the very top, not buried at the bottom.
successCondition: Book two shipments in sequence (the second strictly after the first). GET /api/tracking with no sort, order, or status query params at all returns items where the second (later) shipment appears before the first (earlier) one in the array — confirming the documented default of sort=createdAt, order=desc.
hints: Confirm the two shipments' createdAt timestamps are genuinely distinct and in the order you expect before asserting on array position.
If your account can see other pre-existing shipments too, just check the relative order of your two known shipments within the array, not that they're the very first two entries overall.
